name: crash-course-builder
description: A local-first AI crash course builder.

scripts.dev: npm run build:contracts && concurrently -k -n contracts,server,web -c gray,blue,green "npm:dev:contracts" "npm:dev:server" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @ccb/contracts && npm run build -w @ccb/web && npm run build -w @ccb/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:contracts && npm run typecheck -w @ccb/contracts && npm run typecheck -w @ccb/server && npm run typecheck -w @ccb/web && tsc -p e2e/tsconfig.json
scripts.test: npm run test -w @ccb/contracts && npm run test -w @ccb/server && npm run test -w @ccb/web
scripts.test:coverage: npm run build:contracts && npm run test:coverage -w @ccb/contracts && npm run test:coverage -w @ccb/server && npm run test:coverage -w @ccb/web
scripts.validate:contracts: npm run build:contracts && npm run test -w @ccb/contracts
scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run validate:contracts && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.clean: rimraf apps/server/dist apps/web/dist apps/web/.angular packages/contracts/dist coverage playwright-report test-results .tmp
